summary.text: Kenyatté Hassell, a Democrat, has represented District 78 in the Alabama House of Representatives since September 8, 2021, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, he was born in Montgomery, Alabama.
His career includes work as urban director of YoungLife of Montgomery and as manager of Heritage Barbershop.
